data.body: RP-06 D6.2 approved (2026-08-18): for project.* code-review LLM criteria, require applies_to to be a non-empty list of non-empty repository-relative globs. ["**"] is the explicit repository-wide spelling. No match records typed skipped/non-applicable provenance. Migrate project.review-phase-boundaries from [] to ["**"] at cutover to preserve its current all-review membership. Built-in criteria retain their existing empty-list secondary-trigger meanings; project DET remains detector-selected; plan review retains applies_at/trigger semantics. Validation must fail loudly rather than normalize an empty selector. Evidence and migration rationale: .joe-janitor/rp06-empty-applies-to.md (audited origin/main 5833794fe97ab07628dda657d8ce8ea9c30476e5). No tracked or production file changed.
